## Key Points for Timing the Final Irrigation

1. Determine crop growth stage and anticipated remaining water use
2. Determine soil water status in the field by probe or calibrated soil sensor technology
3. Determine the irrigation strategy necessary to meet the remaining crop water use while maintaining soil water content at or above 55% (limit depletion to 45%).
4. Be ready to make adjustments based on changes in ET demand, precipitation, and other factors. [...] Department of Agronomy
